calibration.note: Earth A100 measurements are a reference, not onboard calibration. 30/60 s step profiles and 256 kbps/1 Mbps radio rates are assumptions.

energy_scope: Posthoc client-active energy sensitivity: compute 10/50 W, radio 5/20 W. No energy-aware admission, calibrated spacecraft power or battery/thermal feasibility claim.

geometry.geometry: Synthetic SGP4 mean elements, WGS72; altitude seeds mean motion only

details.meaning: CPU scheduling execution only; completed steps are planned for later actual training, not GPU-executed quality.

scope: CPU-only planned execution; one selected scenario and one training seed for bounded GPU confirmation. No model-quality inference from CPU results.

gpu.scope: Four actual five-GPU trajectories, one selected synthetic outage scenario and one training seed. CPU counts must match actual work/delivery. No broad quality-win, flight-calibration or replicated quality claim.
